disclaimer: Illustrative portfolio snapshot, not a live catalogue or funding advice. Budgets and deadlines are programme-level summaries; verify the linked official source before acting.

calls.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 4 — Digital, Industry and Space
calls.summary: Collaborative research and innovation topics covering trustworthy AI, data, robotics, advanced computing, manufacturing and space.
calls.countryNotes: Applicants are generally established in EU Member States or countries associated to Horizon Europe; each topic can narrow eligibility.

funding.cofundingRate: Typically 70–100%, depending on action and organisation

deadline.label: 2026 topic-specific; verify the Funding & Tenders topic

calls.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 — Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society
calls.summary: Collaborative R&D for democracy, governance, social transformation and cultural heritage, including public-sector innovation and digital participation.
calls.countryNotes: EU and Horizon Europe associated-country entities may participate subject to the topic conditions.

funding.cofundingRate: Typically 70–100%, depending on action and organisation

deadline.label: 2026 topic-specific; verify the Funding & Tenders topic

calls.title: Horizon Europe — EU Missions
calls.summary: Mission-oriented calls for climate adaptation, cancer, oceans, climate-neutral cities and soil, often involving cities, regions and research consortia.
calls.countryNotes: Participation follows Horizon Europe rules and the conditions of the individual Mission topic.

deadline.label: Mission call-specific; verify current topics

calls.title: EIC Accelerator Open
calls.summary: Supports startups and SMEs developing high-risk, high-impact innovations with potential to create or disrupt markets.
calls.countryNotes: Single startups and SMEs in EU Member States or associated countries can apply; certain individuals may apply intending to establish an eligible company.

funding.budgetLabel: Grant component below €2.5m, with possible EIC equity
funding.cofundingRate: Grant usually funds up to 70% of eligible innovation costs

deadline.label: Short application continuously open; full-application cut-offs vary

calls.title: EIC Accelerator Challenges
calls.summary: Challenge-led Accelerator funding for startups and SMEs addressing strategic technology priorities named in the current EIC work programme.
calls.countryNotes: Eligibility broadly follows EIC Accelerator rules, plus the scope of the selected Challenge.

funding.budgetLabel: Grant component below €2.5m, with possible EIC equity
funding.cofundingRate: Grant usually funds up to 70% of eligible innovation costs

deadline.label: Current work-programme cut-offs; verify the selected Challenge

calls.title: EIC Pathfinder Open
calls.summary: Funds interdisciplinary teams pursuing radically new, high-risk technologies at an early stage without a prescribed thematic challenge.
calls.countryNotes: Normally a consortium of at least three independent entities from different eligible countries; consult the work programme.

funding.budgetLabel: Grants typically up to €3m for Pathfinder Open

deadline.label: Annual call; verify current EIC work programme

calls.title: EIC Pathfinder Challenges
calls.summary: Early-stage deep-tech research aligned with focused strategic challenges in the current EIC work programme.
calls.countryNotes: Single applicants or small consortia may be possible depending on the Challenge; large companies cannot apply alone.

deadline.label: Annual Challenge deadline; verify current work programme

calls.title: EIC Transition
calls.summary: Matures promising results from eligible EU-funded research into validated technologies and credible business cases.
calls.countryNotes: Applicants must build on results from an eligible prior project and meet current work-programme conditions.

deadline.label: Annual cut-off; verify current EIC work programme

calls.title: Digital Europe — Artificial Intelligence and Data
calls.summary: Deployment-oriented funding for European AI, data spaces, testing facilities and adoption of digital capabilities rather than basic research.
calls.countryNotes: Participation depends on Digital Europe association and, for sensitive actions, security restrictions in the specific call.

deadline.label: Work-programme call-specific; verify current calls

calls.title: Digital Europe — Cybersecurity
calls.summary: Builds and deploys advanced cybersecurity capacity, tools, infrastructure and skills across Europe.
calls.countryNotes: Specific cybersecurity calls can restrict participation for security reasons; consult each topic.

deadline.label: Work-programme call-specific; verify current calls

calls.title: Digital Europe — Advanced Digital Skills
calls.summary: Supports specialised education and training in AI, data, cybersecurity, semiconductors and other advanced digital technologies.
calls.countryNotes: Eligible countries and consortium rules are set by the specific Digital Europe topic.

deadline.label: Work-programme call-specific; verify current calls

calls.title: Digital Europe — European Digital Innovation Hubs
calls.summary: Supports regional one-stop hubs that help companies and public organisations test and adopt digital technologies.
calls.countryNotes: EDIH selections and calls involve national designation and Digital Europe conditions.

funding.cofundingRate: Usually co-funded with Member State or regional resources

deadline.label: Network and call-specific; verify current EDIH opportunities

source.label: European Commission — European Digital Innovation Hubs

calls.title: LIFE — Nature and Biodiversity
calls.summary: Funds projects that protect and restore nature, halt biodiversity loss and support implementation of EU nature policy.
calls.countryNotes: Legal entities in eligible LIFE countries can apply; consult the annual call conditions.

funding.budgetLabel: Annual LIFE call; project budget varies

deadline.label: Annual LIFE calls; verify the current call package

calls.title: LIFE — Circular Economy and Quality of Life
calls.summary: Demonstration and implementation projects for circular economy, pollution reduction, water, waste, air and environmental governance.
calls.countryNotes: Legal entities in eligible LIFE countries can apply; annual call documents control.

funding.budgetLabel: Annual LIFE call; project budget varies

deadline.label: Annual LIFE calls; verify the current call package

calls.title: LIFE — Climate Change Mitigation and Adaptation
calls.summary: Demonstrates and scales solutions for emissions reduction, climate resilience, adaptation planning and climate governance.
calls.countryNotes: Legal entities in eligible LIFE countries can apply; annual call documents control.

funding.budgetLabel: Annual LIFE call; project budget varies

deadline.label: Annual LIFE calls; verify the current call package

calls.title: LIFE — Clean Energy Transition
calls.summary: Coordination and support actions that remove market barriers to energy efficiency, renewables and the clean-energy transition.
calls.countryNotes: Call topics specify eligible countries, applicant profiles and consortium composition.

funding.cofundingRate: Often up to 95% for Clean Energy Transition actions

deadline.label: Annual LIFE calls; verify the current call package

calls.title: European Regional Development Fund — Innovation and Digital Transition
calls.summary: Shared-management regional funding for innovation, SME competitiveness, digitisation and place-based development, accessed through national or regional programmes.
calls.countryNotes: Applicants use the managing authority and programme for the project region; rules vary by Member State and region.

funding.budgetLabel: Regional call-specific grant or financial instrument
funding.cofundingRate: Set by the national or regional programme

deadline.label: National or regional call-specific

calls.title: Interreg Europe
calls.summary: Interregional cooperation projects help public authorities improve regional-development policies by exchanging and transferring practices across Europe.
calls.countryNotes: Partners come from eligible Interreg Europe programme countries; private for-profit bodies are generally not direct funding recipients.

funding.cofundingRate: Programme co-financing rate depends on partner country and type

deadline.label: Periodic programme calls; verify current call status

source.label: Interreg Europe — What is the programme?

calls.title: European Urban Initiative — Innovative Actions
calls.summary: Tests bold, transferable solutions to urban challenges through projects led by eligible urban authorities.
calls.countryNotes: Main applicants are eligible EU urban authorities or associations/groupings of urban authorities under the call terms.

funding.budgetLabel: Call-specific ERDF grant for urban innovative actions
funding.cofundingRate: ERDF co-financing under the call conditions

deadline.label: Periodic calls; verify the current EUI call

calls.title: Connecting Europe Facility — Digital
calls.summary: Supports strategic, high-capacity digital connectivity infrastructure such as backbone networks, 5G corridors and connected communities.
calls.countryNotes: Eligibility and security restrictions depend on the call topic and infrastructure concerned.

deadline.label: Periodic CEF Digital calls; verify current topics

calls.title: Connecting Europe Facility — Transport
calls.summary: Funds sustainable, safe and connected trans-European transport infrastructure, including alternative-fuel and cross-border projects.
calls.countryNotes: Member State agreement may be required, and eligibility depends on the relevant TEN-T or transport call.

deadline.label: Periodic CEF Transport calls; verify current topics

calls.title: EU Innovation Fund
calls.summary: Supports commercial demonstration of innovative low-carbon technologies and industrial decarbonisation, financed through the EU Emissions Trading System.
calls.countryNotes: Projects must be located in eligible countries and meet the selected call's sector and maturity conditions.

funding.cofundingRate: May fund up to 60% of relevant costs under standard calls

deadline.label: Periodic net-zero technology calls and auctions

calls.title: Single Market Programme — SME Competitiveness (COSME)
calls.summary: Supports actions that improve SME competitiveness, entrepreneurship, market access and the business environment, often through intermediary organisations.
calls.countryNotes: Direct call eligibility varies; many actions fund networks or intermediaries rather than individual companies.

deadline.label: Call-specific; verify the Funding & Tenders portal

calls.title: EU4Health Programme
calls.summary: Health-sector calls for crisis preparedness, disease prevention, stronger health systems, access to care and digital health.
calls.countryNotes: Eligibility depends on the annual work programme and action; some grants target designated authorities or health bodies.

deadline.label: Annual work-programme call-specific

calls.title: Creative Europe — MEDIA
calls.summary: Supports development, distribution, innovation and cross-border collaboration in Europe's film, television, games and audiovisual sectors.
calls.countryNotes: Applicants must be established in participating Creative Europe countries and meet the action-specific track-record rules.

deadline.label: Annual action-specific calls

calls.title: Erasmus+ Cooperation Partnerships
calls.summary: Transnational partnerships that improve practices, build organisational capacity and create reusable results in education, training, youth and sport.
calls.countryNotes: Organisations in Erasmus+ programme countries can coordinate; partner-country participation is action-specific.

funding.budgetLabel: Predefined lump-sum grant selected in the annual call

deadline.label: Annual Erasmus+ call deadline

calls.title: Erasmus+ Alliances for Innovation
calls.summary: Large partnerships between education providers and businesses that address skills gaps, build curricula and foster innovation.
calls.countryNotes: Requires a broad multi-country partnership with composition rules set by the lot and annual guide.

deadline.label: Annual Erasmus+ call deadline

calls.title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions — Postdoctoral Fellowships
calls.summary: Supports researchers' mobility, advanced training and career development through an individual fellowship hosted by an eligible organisation.
calls.countryNotes: A researcher applies jointly with a host; mobility, experience and host-location rules apply.

funding.budgetLabel: Unit-cost fellowship covering researcher and institutional contributions
funding.cofundingRate: Unit costs defined in the work programme

deadline.label: Annual MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships deadline

calls.title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions — Doctoral Networks
calls.summary: International doctoral programmes delivered by partnerships of universities, research organisations, businesses and other socioeconomic actors.
calls.countryNotes: Multi-country network and beneficiary composition rules apply; candidates are recruited after award.

funding.cofundingRate: Unit costs defined in the work programme

deadline.label: Annual MSCA Doctoral Networks deadline

calls.title: Eurostars
calls.summary: International collaborative R&D funding led by an innovative SME, with national funding decisions for approved projects.
calls.countryNotes: The consortium is led by an innovative SME from a Eurostars country and includes at least two independent entities from at least two Eurostars countries; national rules also apply.

funding.budgetLabel: National funding rates and caps apply to each partner

deadline.label: Usually two international calls per year; verify the current call
